maya: Quick announce 11 weekly release train rolling now. Tag=release-2024.09.0. Canary on model-proxy at 8% to start. Release freeze: Fri 18:00 PT -> Mon 06:00 PT. Exceptions via #release-requests. Plan: https://go.redwood/releases/2024-09-0 :train:
release-bot: Deploy event: service=model-proxy, env=canary, tag=release-2024.09.0, canary=8% :white_check_mark:
ali: Any client changes for Private/on-prem? Need to coordinate upgrades with Support if so.
maya: One small config rename: RW_CACHE_MODE -> RW_CACHE_STRATEGY. Backcompat shim included but we'll cut agent 3.0.0 for Private next week. Migration notes: https://go.redwood/migrate-3-0
sre-oncall: Observability: small tail latency bump in asia-south1 at 03:12 UTC, looks correlated with canary traffic pattern. Investigating.
infra: Health check for canary: `curl -sS https://canary.model.redwood.dev/health` -> "ok", version=release-2024.09.0-canary.
release-bot: Canary progress: model-proxy 8% -> 40% (2024-09-12T03:45Z). No error budget alerts.
product: Owners, please run the smoke checklist before we hit 60% and confirm here: https://go.redwood/smoke. Leave a :thumbsup: when done.
ali: Smoke run passed for embedding flows. :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: Latency normalized after pod reschedule; alert cleared. Continuing to watch for 15m.
release-bot: Canary progress: model-proxy 40% -> 70% (2024-09-12T04:20Z).
infra: Noted increased memory on one canary pod to 74% but stable. SRE watching.
release-bot: Canary progress: model-proxy 70% -> 100% (2024-09-12T04:52Z). Post-deploy checks running.
infra: Post-deploy smoke: all green, version=release-2024.09.0.
product: Sent Private advisory draft to #customer-ops, will schedule agent 3.0.0 repo upload.
maya: Train complete 1 Thanks team. Reminder: freeze active, follow #release-requests for exceptions. Will update the release board and close the ticket. :tada:
